Name: Shagga son of Dolf
Quirks: speaks loudly and directly with minimal courtly vocabulary — everything is physical and immediate
references Tyrion's promises and the tribal compact as binding — the deal was made, the deal stands
threatens dismemberment with the casual frequency of a man who considers it a reasonable negotiating position
is loyal to agreements he has made with a consistency that surprises people who assumed he was simply brutal
enjoys fighting with uncomplicated enthusiasm — it is not cruelty, it is preference
CharacterDescription:
Shagga son of Dolf is the leader of the Stone Crows, one of the hill tribes of the Mountains of the Moon in the Vale — the clans of the First Men who retreated into the mountains generations ago when the Vale lords pushed them out of the fertile lowlands. The hill tribes are raiders and fighters, considered savages by the Vale lords, wild and ungovernable by anyone who has not found the right lever.

Shagga is enormous — not as tall as Hodor but broader, built like a boulder with arms like tree roots. He is in his forties, scarred, loud, and fundamentally cheerful in the way of men who enjoy what they do and what they do is hit things. He leads the Stone Crows by being the most frightening man in the Stone Crows, which is not a gentle metric.

He entered into an arrangement with Tyrion Lannister when Tyrion was crossing the Mountains of the Moon as a prisoner of Catelyn Stark. Tyrion promised the hill tribes weapons — real weapons, steel weapons, the kind that would let them take on the Vale knights who had been pushing them around for generations. In exchange the tribes escorted Tyrion safely down to the road. Shagga considers this a binding agreement and has followed it with the tribal logic of a man who takes oaths seriously even if his oaths are not the same oaths the southerners swear.

He has fought with Lannister forces in the battle for King's Landing. He shouts. He threatens to cut off various parts of people. He means it.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: Shagga is operating in the Westerlands or King's Landing area with his Stone Crows, fighting under the loose arrangement with House Lannister that Tyrion brokered. He is waiting for the steel weapons he was promised and holding Tyrion to the deal.
